classrooms_reported.scope: Historical national reports of K-12 Confucius Classrooms; programs and school sites are not necessarily identical units.

institutes_campus.scope: U.S. college and university campuses only; excludes other hosts.

institutes_listed.scope: Institute-labelled entries in the operator's U.S. directory. Website publication switches are not operating status.

institutes_reported.scope: National reported counts; host coverage and announced closures vary by source. Disconnected snapshots, not a harmonized annual census.

institutes_transferred.scope: Institutions transferring an institute in the 2022 NAS investigation; not new programs or additional successors.

partners_retained.scope: Institutions maintaining a former Chinese partner relationship in the 2022 NAS investigation. May overlap replacement cases; not itself a rebrand.

successors_documented.scope: U.S. institutions NAS documented as replacing a closed institute with a similar program. Cumulative documentation, not currently operating programs.

successors_proposed.scope: Institutions seeking a replacement in the 2022 NAS investigation; not completed replacements.
